race.title: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Handicap
race.verdict: ENACTING shaped very well on recent comeback run and is taken to prove too good for more exposed rivals. Caragio has won twice at this track in recent weeks and moved through the race as if still on a winnable mark when second at Newmarket 18 days ago so is set to prove the biggest danger, while Chalk Mountain will be well suited by a well-run race and can figure if getting the breaks. ENACTING (IRE) CARAGIO (IRE) CHALK MOUNTAIN
